direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; columns 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before reducing type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge SVG labels under 11px and strengthen contrast on JOB-1001/JOB-1002 due lines so the discrepancy reads at 1366x768 without zoom.
Reduce duplicated option cards inside the stage or link each card bidirectionally to its inspector evidence row to cut competing focus areas.
Add visible focus ring and aria-current treatment to the active rail item and evidence disclosure for keyboard scanning.
Keep Route health pre-flight for nonce and identity as a separate labelled group from Investigation source evidence, with independent status text and controls.
Enlarge the small route explanatory copy to 13px and give the select a 40px height with a clear focus ring.
Compress vertical whitespace in the stage evidence strip so the primary Run Sample investigation action remains visible without crowding.
Make the three Select this path controls a proper radio group with arrow-key movement, checked state, and focus ring; selecting one must open the typed consent form.
Add a concise selected-state summary slot above Human Decision so users know consent is still pending before using Review recovery option.
Align option finish and cost metrics on a shared baseline and enlarge secondary labels to 11px minimum.
Preserve the untracked-until-approval state, but enlarge the t1/t2/t3 selector targets and show task count plus approval consequence in one status sentence.
Remove duplicate task detail between stage and inspector by making stage tiles select and highlight the matching inspector task.
Give Review proposed tasks and Decline proposal equal visual clarity while keeping Approve Britt's proposal as the single neon primary.
Make the CELL-MILL-2 preview visually distinct with hatch and PREVIEW text while reserving solid red stopped treatment for the applied offline state.
Enlarge the machine selector to 40px and pair it with an explicit focus ring and keyboard-readable consequence line.
Tighten the lower option-card row so route lines to JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 remain unobstructed at 768px height.
Retain red only on stopped CELL-MILL-2 and ensure no feasible route is drawn through it; add text plus hatch so state does not rely on color alone.
Keep pre-flight nonce and identity checks separate from the investigation evidence panel, and enlarge their status line for faster scanning.
Raise constrained Split card contrast and label it with icon, hatch and text in both stage and inspector contexts.
Ensure constrained Split available capacity is non-selectable, announced as unavailable, and excluded from keyboard activation.
Add selected-state placeholder in Human Decision explaining that choosing a feasible path opens the typed consent form for the revised plan.
Enlarge the 40 parts and 30 parts job labels and connect their total to the 70-unit status in the stage header area.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks visually separate from 3 proposed replacements, with distinct headings, markers and counts in both stage and inspector.
Fix inspector scrolling so blocked list, proposed list and approval actions are reachable without hiding the Approve revised tasks primary.
Enlarge t1/t2/t3 targets and synchronize selection highlighting between stage tiles and inspector task detail.
Sequence Verify ledger, Seal packet and Retain checkpoint with locked states, focus order and aria-live completion announcements.
Enlarge passphrase guidance and error text, associate them programmatically with the input, and keep the field within the 768px viewport.
Make the three stage proof cards reflect the same Ready/Locked state text as the inspector checklist.
Add a single completion focus target and aria-live summary stating packet sealed, 18 events retained and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained.
Keep the sealed checkmarks paired with SEALED text and pattern so completion is not conveyed by color alone.
Provide one clear Back or review-evidence action without adding another primary that competes with the completion status bar.
